ctx.x: Were you there then? No, but I said I know Black Happy now. Sammy Duque, you remember him?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: He's got Sammy D'Angie or something like that.

ctx.x: It's best not to interrupt him. Don't interrupt him. You know, when he gets started on something like Steve Lewis, ask him what he was going to say about Steve.

He said, what you going to say about Steve? Steve, do you play with me? I play by myself. He said, you know, ask my cornet and jambore to play. He said, you know, just sing and holler, you know, like that. He's got Sammy D'Angie or something like that. Sammy D'Angie. I've used to say he could read there, because he wouldn't have been with Piranha if he couldn't read. No, that's a good one. I don't know.
Some fella like, you like that day? I was the one called out there, he knew the day, after
